decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposal, because of its design and appearance, is considered acceptable as it would relate well to its site and would not harm either the appearance of the surrounding area or the living conditions of neighbours. The proposed developments therefore comply with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The detached outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as No. 163, Kingsley Road and for no other purpose (e.g. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room or office)
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing house and erection of a detached building in rear end of garden for use as a leisure room.
